name: PublishStorybook
description: Publish a built Storybook as a build artifact so it can be browsed in the "Storybook" tab of the pipeline run.
helpMarkDown: Packs the folder written by `storybook build` into a zip and publishes it as a build artifact of the run. Open the run and select the **Storybook** tab to browse the stories, with no download needed.
author: Shko Online

inputs.name: storybookDir
inputs.label: Storybook folder
inputs.helpMarkDown: Folder that contains the built Storybook: the output of `storybook build`, `storybook-static` unless you passed `--output-dir`. Relative paths are resolved against `$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)`.

inputs.name: artifactName
inputs.label: Artifact name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name of the build artifact that holds the Storybook, as `storybook.zip`. It is listed with the other artifacts of the run and must differ from their names. Give each Storybook its own artifact name when a run publishes more than one.

inputs.name: title
inputs.label: Title
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name shown in the tab, for example `Design system`. Defaults to the artifact name.

inputs.name: ifMissing
inputs.label: When the Storybook folder is missing
inputs.helpMarkDown: What to do when the Storybook folder or its `index.html` cannot be found (for example when the build step was skipped).
